answer: Each new identity must lock a refundable bond in a public atlas that maps one live key to one slot. The bond sits on a slash ledge: when peers show two slots sharing a telemetry cluster or recycling a work-provenance graph, a quorum countersigns a burn and evicts the colliding slots. A sybil farm therefore pays a full ledge-bond per fake head, and burned keys cannot be reused. Emission is a river that only reaches atlas-registered slots whose bonds remain above the ledge, so unbacked clones earn nothing and honest peers enforce the cut on-ledger.
